experiment: ERA on AgentDescent -- SWE-bench Science, one tree per task
protocol: ERA's, not the benchmark's: the leaderboard gives an agent one attempt per task with no verifier feedback, while this scores a tree of agent sessions against the visible part of each private suite and keeps the best node. `benchmark_reward_*` is the release's own grader over the whole private suite; the search never reads it.

diff --git a/source/Bio/SeqFeature.py b/source/Bio/SeqFeature.py
index 394c839..5e311d2 100644
--- a/source/Bio/SeqFeature.py
+++ b/source/Bio/SeqFeature.py
@@ -1710,10 +1710,20 @@ class CompoundLocation(Location):
         versions of Biopython which would have given join{[5:29](-), [37:52](-)}
         and the translation would have wrongly been "EXAMPLE*SILLY" instead.
 
+        The above only holds when the parts have a defined strand (+1 or -1),
+        because in that case ``SimpleLocation._flip`` also reverse-complements
+        each part, which combined with keeping the same part order preserves
+        the biological (5' to 3') order. When the strand is not defined (None
+        or 0), flipping a part only mirrors its coordinates - it does not
+        complement its extracted bases - so the parts themselves must be
+        reversed here to still describe the same, correctly assembled,
+        sequence once the parent is reverse complemented.
+
         """
-        return CompoundLocation(
-            [loc._flip(length) for loc in self.parts], self.operator
-        )
+        parts = [loc._flip(length) for loc in self.parts]
+        if self.strand not in (+1, -1):
+            parts.reverse()
+        return CompoundLocation(parts, self.operator)
 
     @property
     def start(self):
